comment: Assemblies whose full member surface is stored in every baseline. Keep this to assemblies a Revit-side project actually redistributes: indexing everything Revit ships costs about 5 MB per version for libraries no add-in would ever carry. RefCheck emits RVTREF004 when the build references a Revit-shipped assembly that is missing here, so gaps report themselves - add the name, re-collect, commit. See readme.md for why each entry is on the list.
